sources.researchNote: The uploader dates Gauty’s recording to 1934. A Polydor label photograph appears in the slideshow, but the catalogue and matrix numbers were not independently read at sufficient resolution during this review. Frémeaux & Associés’ official FA 5033 discography, separately documented at SRC0884, identifies Gauty’s Paris session of 18 October 1934, Polydor 522987 and matrix 1444 WPP. That documents the historical recording, but does not by itself establish the pressing or take reproduced in this upload. The structured date remains YouTube publication on 15 August 2011.

works.title: Le bistrot du port
works.publicNote: Valse written for the singer Lys Gauty, to words by Gaston Groener and A. Saudemont; the printed edition (Paris: Coda, cop. 1934) credits the music to Pierre Candel, a pseudonym standing here for Kaper and Jurmann together. In his 1975 AFI oral history Kaper recalled it as the last song he wrote in Paris, and said he never heard it there before leaving for the United States.

contributions.scopeNote: Recorded the song in Paris on 18 October 1934 with the orchestra of Wal Berg; Polydor 522987, matrix 1444 WPP.
